_comment: Source setup probe for a rejected monster-target acid-wand idea. NetHack has no WAN_ACID entry in objects.h; wish of “wand of acid” resolved to an unidentified platinum wand (WAN_CANCELLATION). The adjacent sergeant is armored by makemon.c:m_initinv, and the inventory frame recorded slot e, but this invalid wand does not produce ZT_ACID. Probe run-YFEvns is preserved as a setup miss, not runtime evidence.
